legend: Dermatological presentation with generalized papular eruption.

Dermal infiltrate made up of mononuclear cells with rounded to indented nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm. The epidermis is partially involved (<<#29981>>). Tumour cells are positive for CD1a (<<#35933>>), negative for CD207 (langerin) (<<#35934>>), and positive for fascin (<<#35935>>).

diagnosis: Indeterminate dendritic cell tumour of skin
legend: Tumour cells infiltrate the papillary and reticular dermis (<<31347>>). The infiltrate is made up of mononuclear cells with rounded to indented nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm (<<35932>>). High magnification reveals deeply grooved nuclei and fine chromatin (<<31349>>). The tumour cells are positive for CD1a (<<31352>>).
